test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of Interest (R) = 7% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100)

**Calculation:**

SI = ₹2000 × 7% × 4 years

SI = (2000 times 7 times 4)/(100)

SI = (56000)/(100)

SI = ₹560

**The simple interest is ₹560.**
